history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1821 in Kentucky and came to Chicago about 1862. He works as a tinsmith, and the household lives on the South Side near Twelfth and State streets. The family's church is Quinn Chapel.
